label: Drought index, ensemble mean
source: Ensemble of 4 drought indices: SPEI-3 IMERG/MERRA-2 (drive_climate spei3), SPI-3 CHIRPS v3.0, SPEI-3 TerraClimate, TerraClimate PDSI standardised (scripts/drought_ensemble.py)
notes: Mean of standardised 3-month drought indices from independent rainfall inputs (satellite IMERG, gauge-blended CHIRPS, reanalysis-driven TerraClimate). <-1 moderate, <-1.5 severe drought. Members use different baselines (TerraClimate/CHIRPS 1991-2020; IMERG SPEI 2000-2026). Pooled 2018-2025 county-month correlations between members: CHIRPS SPI vs IMERG SPEI r=0.39, CHIRPS SPI vs TC SPEI r=0.34, IMERG SPEI vs TC SPEI r=0.31, TC SPEI vs TC PDSI-z r=0.45.

label: Drought uncertainty (ensemble spread)
source: Ensemble of 4 drought indices: SPEI-3 IMERG/MERRA-2 (drive_climate spei3), SPI-3 CHIRPS v3.0, SPEI-3 TerraClimate, TerraClimate PDSI standardised (scripts/drought_ensemble.py)
notes: How much the drought indices disagree. <0.5: inputs agree; >1: the sign or severity of the anomaly depends on which rainfall product you trust (typical in the Sudd and Upper Nile, where there are almost no rain gauges). Pooled 2018-2025 county-month correlations between members: CHIRPS SPI vs IMERG SPEI r=0.39, CHIRPS SPI vs TC SPEI r=0.34, IMERG SPEI vs TC SPEI r=0.31, TC SPEI vs TC PDSI-z r=0.45.

label: Drought index range (max - min of members)
source: Ensemble of 4 drought indices: SPEI-3 IMERG/MERRA-2 (drive_climate spei3), SPI-3 CHIRPS v3.0, SPEI-3 TerraClimate, TerraClimate PDSI standardised (scripts/drought_ensemble.py)
notes: Alternative uncertainty measure to the spread.

label: Drought index sign agreement
source: Ensemble of 4 drought indices: SPEI-3 IMERG/MERRA-2 (drive_climate spei3), SPI-3 CHIRPS v3.0, SPEI-3 TerraClimate, TerraClimate PDSI standardised (scripts/drought_ensemble.py)
aggregation: share of members with same sign as mean
notes: 1 = all members agree whether the county is drier or wetter than normal.

label: SPI-3 (CHIRPS rainfall)
aggregation: county-mean rainfall, 3-month sum, gamma SPI vs 1991-2020
notes: Gamma distribution with zero-rain probability per county and calendar month; dry-season months with near-zero rain give unstable SPI (bounded to +-3.09).

label: SPEI-3 (TerraClimate)
aggregation: county-mean P-PET, 3-month sum, log-logistic SPEI vs 1991-2020
notes: TerraClimate precipitation is ~40% below IMERG in 2018-2025 and its recent years are anomalously dry relative to 1991-2020 (it inherits ERA5/CRU trends), so this member is biased toward drought.

label: PDSI, re-standardised (TerraClimate)
aggregation: county-mean PDSI, z-score vs the county's 1991-2020 values for the same calendar month
notes: PDSI has long memory (~9-12 months) so it lags SPI/SPEI-3; it shares the TerraClimate precipitation with dr_spei3_tc, so these two members are not independent.
